findings.evidence: TangentSpace.lean:52-196 use only `η[A.toOver]`, `residueFieldIsoOfSection`, `section_apply` (RationalPoint/Basic.lean:67,141) — no `ZariskiTangentSpace`; grep shows `η[A.toOver].left` already appearing at Trivial.lean:252.
findings.fix: Move `zeroSection`/`zeroSection_comp_toOver_hom`/`zeroPoint`/`toOver_hom_zeroPoint` into `TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/AbelianVariety/Basic.lean` next to the `GrpObj` structure, and the residue-field identification (`zeroResidueFieldIso` .. `zeroResidueFieldRingEquiv_algebraMap` and the `Algebra` instance) into `Basic.lean` (adding `public import TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.RationalPoint.Basic`, which only imports `ResidueDegree`, so no cycle) or a new `AbelianVariety/ZeroPoint.lean`; leave `TangentSpace.lean` with `tangentSpace` and the finrank results. Restate `Trivial.lean:250` with `A.zeroSection`.
findings.issue: `zeroSection`, `zeroSection_comp_toOver_hom`, `zeroPoint`, `toOver_hom_zeroPoint`, `zeroResidueFieldIso`(+`_hom`/`_inv`), `zeroResidueFieldRingEquiv`(+ its lemmas and the `Algebra K κ(0)` instance) — lines 52–196 — are the identity-point API of an abelian variety and depend on no tangent-space theory (only `AbelianVariety.Basic` and `RationalPoint.Basic`). Placing them in a module named `TangentSpace` forces any consumer of the identity point (torsion, isogeny kernels, formal groups) to import the tangent-space file, and earlier files cannot use them: `Trivial.lean:252` already states `toSchemeHom_fromTrivial` in terms of the raw `η[A.toOver].left` with a docstring calling it "the unit section of `A`", precisely `zeroSection`.

findings.evidence: TangentSpace.lean:80-85: the statement mentions only `K`, `Spec`, `Ideal.algEquivResidueFieldOfField`; no `AbelianVariety` argument appears.
findings.fix: Move it to a general scheme-level file (e.g. `TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/RationalPoint/Basic.lean`, whose topic is residue fields at sections/rational points) and make it public, dropping the `private`.
findings.issue: `baseResidueFieldIso K : (Spec (.of K)).residueField (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K) ≅ .of K` is a general fact about `Spec` of a field, unrelated to abelian varieties, kept `private` inside `namespace AbelianVariety`. The next consumer of κ(closed point of Spec K) ≅ K must re-prove it.

summary: Imports in both new files are used and the new TangentSpace/ subdirectory is placed correctly, but the identity-section/identity-point/residue-field API in AbelianVariety/TangentSpace.lean uses no tangent-space theory and belongs in an earlier abelian-variety file; a general Spec-of-a-field fact is also buried there as a private helper.
